sources.title: GitHub - alphacep/vosk-tts: Text To Speech Synthesis with Vosk
sources.snippet: For now we support several Russian voices 3 females and 2 males. Get the model here: vosk-model-tts-ru-.9-multi You can use speaker IDs from 0 to 4 included. We plan to add more voices and languages in the future.

sources.snippet: Vosk TTS Simple TTS based on VITS with some old ideas Usage Command line pip3 install vosk-tts vosk-tts -n vosk-model-tts-ru-.9-multi -s 2 --input "Привет мир!" --output out.wav API from vosk_tts import Model, Synth model = Model(model_name="vosk-model-tts-ru-.9-multi") synth = Synth(model) synth.synth("Привет мир!", "out.wav", speaker_id=2) Voices For now we support ...
